blogPosts.title: How Much Does Concrete Grinding and Polishing Cost in Torquay?
blogPosts.excerpt: Discover the real costs of concrete grinding and polishing in Torquay. We break down pricing per square metre, factors that affect your quote, and what Surf Coast homeowners should expect in 2026.
body: If you are a Torquay homeowner considering polished concrete for your floors, understanding the true cost is essential before committing to any project. Concrete grinding and polishing in the Torquay and Surf Coast region typically ranges from $50 to $90 per square metre for a standard residential finish, depending on the level of sheen you are after, the condition of your existing slab, and the size of the area. At Concrete Grinding & Polishing Geelong, we have completed hundreds of projects across Torquay, Jan Juc, and Anglesea, and we know that every slab tells a different story. Factors like previous coatings, cracks, moisture levels, and the complexity of the finish all influence the final price. That is why we always provide a detailed, fixed-price quote after assessing your concrete on-site — no guesswork, no hidden costs.

The first factor that affects cost is the condition of your existing concrete slab. In Torquay, many homes built in the 1990s and early 2000s have garage and indoor slabs that were never intended to be a finished surface. These slabs often have adhesives, paint overspray, or old tile adhesive that needs to be removed during the grinding stage. Heavy coating removal can add $10 to $20 per square metre to your project because it requires additional grinding passes with coarser diamond tooling. Conversely, a clean, newly poured slab in good condition can be polished more efficiently, keeping costs toward the lower end of the scale. During our free on-site assessment in Torquay, we evaluate your slab condition and explain exactly what is needed to achieve your desired finish.

The level of polish you choose also plays a significant role in pricing. Concrete polishing is a multi-stage process, and each additional stage adds both time and cost. A honed or matte finish typically involves two to three grinding stages and is the most affordable option, usually sitting at the lower end of the $50 to $70 per square metre range. A semi-gloss or satin finish requires additional passes with finer diamond tooling and the application of a concrete densifier, pushing the cost toward $65 to $80 per square metre. For a high-gloss, mirror-like finish — which is increasingly popular in Torquay's modern beach homes — expect to invest $75 to $90 per square metre or more. Each finish level delivers genuine durability, so the choice often comes down to aesthetic preference and how the space will be used.

Size matters when it comes to concrete grinding and polishing costs. Larger areas benefit from economies of scale because the setup time, equipment transport, and diamond tooling costs are spread across more square metres. For a typical Torquay home with a 40 square metre living area, you might expect a total project cost between $2,200 and $3,600 for a quality polished finish. A larger commercial project of 200 square metres could see per-square-metre rates drop to $45 to $65, making polished concrete an incredibly cost-effective solution for Surf Coast businesses. We always recommend getting at least one on-site assessment to understand the true scope of work — online calculators and generic pricing guides rarely account for the specific conditions of your Torquay slab.

Additional costs that Torquay property owners should budget for include crack repair, joint filling, and edge grinding. Most concrete slabs have control joints and minor shrinkage cracks that need to be filled with colour-matched epoxy before polishing begins. In Torquay, where homes are exposed to coastal moisture and temperature fluctuations, we often see hairline cracks that need attention. Edge grinding around walls, doorways, and fixtures is another consideration — hand-held grinders are required to reach areas that the large walk-behind machines cannot access, and this detail work is priced separately. These additional elements typically add $5 to $15 per square metre to the overall project cost, but they are essential for achieving a seamless, professional finish throughout your Torquay property.

For Surf Coast homeowners weighing up flooring options, polished concrete offers exceptional long-term value compared to alternatives. Tiles require ongoing grout maintenance and can crack under impact, timber floors need sanding and refinishing every few years, and vinyl simply does not last in high-traffic areas. Polished concrete, by contrast, is a one-time investment that will outlast nearly every other flooring option. In Torquay's coastal environment, where sand and salt air are constant companions, polished concrete is remarkably easy to maintain — a simple damp mop and periodic resealing every three to five years is all it takes. When you factor in the zero ongoing maintenance costs and the decades of performance, polished concrete consistently proves to be the most economical choice for Surf Coast properties.

At Concrete Grinding & Polishing Geelong, we provide fixed-price quotes for every project across Torquay, Jan Juc, Anglesea, and the wider Surf Coast. Our pricing includes all grinding, densifying, and polishing stages, so there are never any surprises on the day. We also offer free on-site assessments where we inspect your slab, discuss your desired finish, and provide a detailed written quote — usually within 24 hours. If you are ready to explore polished concrete for your Torquay home or business, call us on 0418 338 194 or visit our Torquay showroom at 3 Flinders Lane. We are passionate about delivering exceptional concrete finishes that Surf Coast property owners can enjoy for decades.

blogPosts.title: Polished Concrete vs Tiles: The Best Flooring Choice for Surf Coast Homes
blogPosts.excerpt: Choosing between polished concrete and tiles for your Surf Coast home? We compare durability, cost, maintenance, and style for Torquay homeowners in this comprehensive guide.
body: Choosing the right flooring for your Surf Coast home is one of the most important decisions you will make during a renovation or new build. In Torquay and across the Surf Coast, two options consistently dominate the conversation: polished concrete and tiles. Both offer durability and visual appeal, but they perform very differently in the unique coastal conditions of southern Victoria. At Concrete Grinding & Polishing Geelong, we have installed and maintained both flooring types across hundreds of Surf Coast properties, giving us a first-hand understanding of how each performs over time. In this guide, we will break down the key differences between polished concrete and tiles to help Torquay homeowners make an informed decision that suits their lifestyle, budget, and the demands of coastal living.

Durability is where polished concrete truly shines, especially in the Surf Coast environment. A properly ground and polished concrete floor is essentially the structural slab itself — there is no separate layer that can crack, delaminate, or lift. In Torquay, where homes experience significant temperature swings between summer heat and winter cold, tiles often suffer from grout cracking and individual tile movement. Polished concrete moves with the slab as a single unit, eliminating these failure points entirely. Furthermore, the coastal salt air that permeates Torquay homes can degrade tile adhesive over time, particularly in areas close to the beach. Polished concrete is sealed with penetrating densifiers that bond at a molecular level, making it impervious to salt air damage — a crucial advantage for properties in Jan Juc, Bells Beach, and other coastal pockets.

Maintenance is another area where polished concrete holds a significant advantage over tiles for Surf Coast homeowners. Tiles require regular grout cleaning, re-sealing, and eventual replacement of cracked or chipped pieces. In a busy Torquay family home, grout lines quickly become stained and discoloured, especially in kitchens, bathrooms, and entryways where sandy feet are a daily reality. Polished concrete offers a completely seamless surface with no grout lines to trap dirt, sand, or moisture. A simple weekly mop with a pH-neutral cleaner is all that is needed to keep your polished floor looking immaculate. For Torquay families who enjoy an active outdoor lifestyle — surfing, mountain biking, and beach walks — polished concrete is the practical flooring choice that keeps up with Surf Coast living.

Cost is naturally a key consideration for any Torquay homeowner, and this is where the comparison gets interesting. The upfront cost of polished concrete and quality tiles can be surprisingly similar when you factor in all expenses. Polished concrete in Torquay typically costs $55 to $90 per square metre, including grinding, densifying, and polishing. Quality porcelain or ceramic tiles, including materials, adhesive, grout, and professional installation, generally range from $60 to $120 per square metre. However, the long-term cost picture tells a different story entirely. Tile re-grouting, cracked tile replacement, and eventual full replacement can add thousands of dollars over a ten-year period. Polished concrete requires nothing more than occasional resealing every three to five years, making it the more economical choice over the life of your Torquay home.

Aesthetic appeal is subjective, but polished concrete offers a versatility that tiles struggle to match. Modern concrete polishing techniques allow for a range of finishes from raw, industrial matte to ultra-high-gloss mirror surfaces. The natural variation in each concrete slab creates a unique, organic aesthetic that cannot be replicated by manufactured tiles. In Torquay's contemporary beach houses, polished concrete provides the clean, minimalist look that complements modern coastal architecture beautifully. Tiles, while available in countless patterns and colours, often feel repetitive and can date quickly as trends change. Additionally, polished concrete can be customised with integral colour, aggregate exposure, and decorative scoring to create truly bespoke flooring solutions. For Torquay homeowners who value individuality and timeless design, polished concrete delivers unmatched visual character.

Environmental considerations are increasingly important to Surf Coast residents, and polished concrete scores well in this category too. The grinding and polishing process uses no additional raw materials — you are working with the existing concrete slab that is already part of your home. Tiles require clay extraction, kiln firing, and international shipping, all of which carry a significant carbon footprint. Polished concrete also contributes to indoor air quality because it produces zero VOC emissions and does not harbour allergens, dust mites, or mould — all common concerns in Torquay's occasionally damp coastal climate. For environmentally conscious homeowners building or renovating on the Surf Coast, polished concrete represents a sustainable flooring choice that reduces waste and eliminates the need for periodic replacement.

For Torquay and Surf Coast homeowners ready to explore polished concrete as an alternative to tiles, the first step is a professional assessment of your existing slab. Not all concrete slabs are suitable for polishing — factors like slab thickness, surface hardness, and moisture content all play a role. At Concrete Grinding & Polishing Geelong, we offer free on-site assessments across Torquay, Jan Juc, Anglesea, and the wider region. We will evaluate your slab, discuss your design preferences, and provide a detailed fixed-price quote. Call us on 0418 338 194 or visit 3 Flinders Lane, Torquay to see our showroom displays. Let us show you why polished concrete is the Surf Coast's smartest flooring investment.

blogPosts.title: How to Maintain Your Polished Concrete Floor on the Victorian Coast
blogPosts.excerpt: Keep your polished concrete floor in perfect condition on the Surf Coast. Our Torquay experts share essential maintenance tips for Victorian coastal homes.
body: Polished concrete is one of the most durable and low-maintenance flooring options available to Victorian homeowners, but the unique coastal conditions along the Surf Coast do present some specific maintenance considerations. In Torquay, where salt-laden air, abrasive sand, and variable humidity are part of daily life, understanding how to properly care for your polished concrete floor will ensure it looks stunning for decades. At Concrete Grinding & Polishing Geelong, we have maintained and serviced polished concrete floors across the Surf Coast for over ten years, and we have developed a clear maintenance framework that keeps our clients' floors in peak condition. Whether your polished floor is in a Torquay beach house, a Jan Juc family home, or a Geelong commercial space, this guide covers everything you need to know.

Daily maintenance of polished concrete in a Torquay home is refreshingly simple compared to other flooring types. The key is keeping abrasive particles — particularly sand, which is unavoidable on the Surf Coast — off the surface. A soft-bristle broom or dust mop used daily will prevent sand from being walked into the floor, where it can act like sandpaper underfoot and gradually dull the polished surface over time. For wet mopping, use a microfibre mop with clean warm water and a pH-neutral floor cleaner. Avoid acidic cleaners like vinegar, bleach, or citrus-based products, as these can react with the concrete densifier and etch the surface. In Torquay homes with direct beach access, placing quality doormats at all entry points is essential for capturing the worst of the sand and moisture before it reaches your polished floor.

Resealing is the most important periodic maintenance task for polished concrete floors in Torquay's coastal environment. The penetrating densifier applied during the polishing process bonds with the concrete at a molecular level, but the surface sealer that provides stain resistance and additional protection does need periodic renewal. Along the Surf Coast, we recommend resealing every two to three years for residential floors and annually for commercial spaces with heavy foot traffic. The resealing process involves a light maintenance grind with very fine diamond pads, followed by the application of a fresh coat of sealer. This restores the floor's resistance to moisture, salt, and staining while refreshing the sheen level. For Torquay homeowners, scheduling resealing before the peak summer season ensures your floor is protected during the busiest period of beach traffic.

Spill management is straightforward but important, particularly in Torquay homes where wine, coffee, and food spills are part of everyday life. The good news is that a properly sealed polished concrete floor is highly resistant to staining. However, acidic substances like red wine, coffee, and citrus juice should be wiped up promptly rather than left to sit, as prolonged exposure can gradually penetrate even the best sealers. For grease and oil stains — common in Torquay garages and workshops — use a neutral degreaser and a soft cloth. Avoid scrubbing aggressively, as this can scratch the polished surface. For stubborn stains that have penetrated the sealer, a professional maintenance service can locally restore the area without needing to re-polish the entire floor.

Coastal air presents a unique challenge that inland Victorian homeowners rarely encounter. Salt particles carried on the breeze from Torquay's beaches can settle on polished concrete floors and attract moisture, potentially creating slippery surfaces and accelerating wear on the sealer. The solution is straightforward — regular damp mopping effectively removes salt deposits before they accumulate. In homes within a few hundred metres of Torquay's coast, we recommend damp mopping two to three times per week during summer when sea breezes are strongest. Using a water softener additive in your mop water can also help dissolve salt crystals more effectively. For Torquay properties with elevated salt exposure, our maintenance team offers a professional desalination cleaning service that deeply removes embedded salt from the concrete surface and reseals it for ongoing protection.

Scratch prevention is another consideration for Surf Coast families. While polished concrete is remarkably hard — scoring a 7 on the Mohs hardness scale after professional treatment — it is not completely immune to scratching from sharp objects. In Torquay households with active children, pets, or furniture that is regularly moved, felt pads on all furniture legs are a small investment that prevents significant damage. Dragging heavy items across a polished floor, particularly one with a high-gloss finish, will leave visible scratches. For entryways where grit is tracked in from Torquay's beaches and trails, we recommend installing recessed floor grates or brush mats that scrape debris from shoes before they reach the polished surface. These simple preventive measures will keep your Torquay home's polished concrete floor looking pristine for years.

Knowing when to call in a professional for polished concrete maintenance is important for protecting your investment. If you notice dull patches, fine surface scratches that catch your fingernail, or areas where water no longer beads on the surface, it is time for a maintenance service. At Concrete Grinding & Polishing Geelong, we offer a comprehensive floor assessment and maintenance program for Torquay and Surf Coast properties. Our service includes a light regrind, densifier reapplication, and fresh sealer coat — typically completed in one to two days for residential spaces. We also provide a free maintenance guide with every polishing project to help our Torquay clients keep their floors in showroom condition between professional services. Call 0418 338 194 to schedule your floor assessment today.

blogPosts.title: Exposed Aggregate Driveways in Torquay: A Complete Guide to Costs and Options
blogPosts.excerpt: Everything Torquay homeowners need to know about exposed aggregate driveways — costs, stone choices, coastal construction tips, and how to choose the right concreter.
body: An exposed aggregate driveway is one of the most popular choices for Torquay homeowners, and for good reason. This finish combines the structural strength of concrete with a textured, visually striking surface that is perfectly suited to the Surf Coast's relaxed coastal aesthetic. Whether you are building a new home in Jan Juc, renovating an existing property on the Torquay foreshore, or upgrading a tired driveway in Bells Beach, exposed aggregate delivers exceptional durability with minimal ongoing maintenance. At Concrete Grinding & Polishing Geelong, we have completed exposed aggregate projects across the entire Surf Coast region, from compact townhouse driveways to large commercial parking areas. In this comprehensive guide, we will walk you through everything Torquay property owners need to know about exposed aggregate driveways, including costs, stone options, and how coastal conditions affect your choice.

The cost of an exposed aggregate driveway in Torquay depends on several factors, including the size of the area, the type of aggregate stone selected, and site access conditions. For a standard residential driveway of approximately 50 square metres, Torquay homeowners can expect to invest between $75 and $120 per square metre, putting the total project cost in the range of $3,750 to $6,000. Premium stone selections such as locally sourced basalt, quartz, or sea-green pebbles can push the per-square-metre rate higher, while more economical granite or recycled glass aggregates offer excellent visual impact at a lower price point. Site-specific factors like steep gradients, difficult access, or the need for extensive excavation will also affect the final quote. We always recommend an on-site assessment to provide an accurate, fixed-price quote tailored to your specific Torquay property.

The choice of aggregate stone is where Torquay homeowners can really personalise their driveway. The Surf Coast has a strong tradition of using locally sourced materials that complement the natural landscape, and exposed aggregate is the perfect opportunity to incorporate this aesthetic. Dark basalt pebbles are a popular choice in Torquay, offering a sophisticated, modern look that pairs beautifully with contemporary beach architecture. Lighter granite aggregates in cream and grey tones suit traditional and Hamptons-style homes common in the area. For a truly coastal feel, sea-green and blue-toned glass aggregates reflect the ocean colours visible from many Torquay properties. We keep a range of aggregate samples at our 3 Flinders Lane showroom so you can see and feel the options in person before making your selection.

Coastal conditions play a significant role in how your exposed aggregate driveway performs over time, and Torquay's location makes this a critical consideration. The combination of salt air, sandy soil, and Victorian weather patterns means your driveway needs to be engineered to handle more than just vehicle traffic. At Concrete Grinding & Polishing Geelong, we prepare every Torquay driveway with a compacted road-base foundation that accounts for the sandy subsoil common throughout the Surf Coast. We use steel reinforcement mesh and control joints strategically placed to manage the thermal expansion and contraction that occurs in Victoria's variable climate. The concrete mix itself is designed with a slightly higher cement content to resist the salt air penetration that can cause surface scaling and aggregate dislodgement in poorly constructed driveways.

One of the greatest advantages of exposed aggregate driveways for Torquay homeowners is the minimal maintenance required compared to other driveway surfaces. Unlike plain concrete, which can show every oil stain and tyre mark, the textured surface of exposed aggregate naturally camouflages minor dirt and wear. A simple annual wash with a pressure cleaner at moderate pressure is usually sufficient to keep the surface looking fresh. The exposed stones are extremely hard-wearing and will not chip or wear away under normal vehicle traffic. For Torquay properties where the driveway doubles as a play area for children or a gathering space for entertaining, the non-slip texture of exposed aggregate provides excellent traction even when wet — a valuable safety feature during Victoria's rainy winter months.

Planning and council considerations are an important part of any driveway project in Torquay. The Surf Coast Shire has specific guidelines regarding driveway construction, including setback requirements, permeable surface ratios, and crossover specifications. A new driveway crossover — the section where your driveway meets the public road — typically requires a permit from the Surf Coast Shire, and the construction must comply with VicRoads standards if it connects to a main road. At Concrete Grinding & Polishing Geelong, we handle the entire process for our Torquay clients, from initial design and material selection through to council liaison and final construction. We have built strong relationships with local council offices and understand the specific requirements for properties throughout Torquay, Jan Juc, and the wider Surf Coast region.

The long-term value that an exposed aggregate driveway adds to a Torquay property is significant. In the competitive Surf Coast real estate market, kerb appeal directly impacts property values, and a well-constructed exposed aggregate driveway creates an immediate impression of quality and attention to detail. Real estate agents across Torquay consistently report that properties with professionally finished driveways sell faster and at higher prices than those with plain or deteriorating concrete surfaces. Beyond aesthetics, the structural durability of a properly engineered exposed aggregate driveway means it will outlast cheaper alternatives like bitumen or plain concrete by decades. For Torquay homeowners considering their options, exposed aggregate represents an investment that pays dividends every time you pull into your driveway.

Ready to transform your Torquay property with a stunning exposed aggregate driveway? Concrete Grinding & Polishing Geelong offers free on-site assessments and fixed-price quotes for driveway projects across the Surf Coast. We carry a wide selection of aggregate samples at our showroom at 3 Flinders Lane, Torquay, where you can see finished textures and discuss colour options with our experienced team. Whether you are planning a new build in Jan Juc, renovating an existing property in Anglesea, or simply upgrading a tired driveway, we will guide you through every step. Call 0418 338 194 today to book your free assessment and discover why Torquay homeowners trust us with their most visible concrete investment.
